name: cicadas-local-mcp
description: Experimental Cicadas local MCP. Customer API key required; authenticated production flows unverified.
long_description: Local stdio bridge for Cicadas.ai, not a hosted remote connector. A valid customer API key is required. The supplied bundle exposes five read/quote tools and disables paid generation. Authenticated production functionality has not yet been verified with a real customer API key. Local contract tests and packaged MCP handshake/tool listing passed; no paid tests were performed. See README.md for scope and limitations.

api_key.title: Cicadas customer API key
api_key.description: Obtain an owner-scoped key from Cicadas developer settings after API access is enabled. Never use a provider or administrator key.
